reviewedBaseline.sizeBudgetRationale: Issues #306 and #308 intentionally add TSDoc to the published TypeScript source tree, increasing package source bytes without changing runtime dependencies. Issue #319 adds horizon-qualified empty-snapshot discovery to insights, growing compiled JS/d.ts source bytes with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #314 adds native no-replay write interruption classification, shared cause-chain helpers, and operator logging for operation_status_unknown, including definitive-status preservation for malformed non-2xx and truncated success bodies with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #332 adds durable-secret fail-safe recovery, Partner response-shape validation, and exact-secret log redaction for newly minted application keys with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #270 adds Streamable HTTP eval coverage plus a standalone HTTP listen-host option so evals can bind loopback-only, increasing CLI/config source and public docs with no new runtime dependencies. The aws-sdk group bump (@aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner 3.1103.0 -> 3.1119.0, with @smithy/types realigned 4.16.1 -> 4.17.2 to keep the reviewed command/type boundary on a single version) grows the reviewed AWS transitive graph slightly with no new direct dependencies. Issue #344 upgrades @backblaze-labs/b2-sdk 0.3.0 -> 0.4.0 so Partner create/reserve tools consume the SDK's single-object durable-secret responses without adding runtime dependencies; review hardening adds Partner successful-response recovery capture, allow-list projections, legacy sink replay, and documented release-age/no-replay evidence. Issue #166 adds MCP workflow prompts, safe-integer bounded prompt argument schemas, and the generated prompt contract surface, growing compiled JS/d.ts source bytes with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #367 expands tool descriptions, generated contracts, and README/LobeHub tool text for TDQS behavior, parameter, and usage-guidance coverage with no new runtime dependencies or package entries. Issue #363 adds credential-free discovery routing and HTTP hardening without changing runtime dependencies. Issue #372 reorganizes published docs into the harness-engineering taxonomy while retaining one-release compatibility aliases for old public doc paths, increasing packed entry count without changing runtime dependencies. Issue #379 adds a root PRIVACY.md privacy policy for directory submissions, adding one packed entry without changing runtime dependencies. Issue #376 continues the TDQS pass 2 by expanding tool descriptions and the generated/LobeHub tool text for b2_reserve_trial_create_account, s3_create_multipart_upload, s3_upload_part_copy, and b2_create_bucket, growing packed bytes without changing runtime dependencies or adding new package entries of its own. The reviewedBaseline.packedEntryCount refresh from 262 to 277 in this change is a catch-up that records packed entries already added by prior merges whose baselines were never refreshed (the docs reorg in #372/#383 plus the PRIVACY.md addition in #379/#381); Issue #376 itself adds no packed entries. Issue #365 renames four tools to the verb-first `<prefix>_<verb>_<noun>` convention (for example `b2_usage_growth` -> `b2_report_usage_growth`); the longer names grow compiled JS/d.ts source bytes and the generated tool-contract/profile docs by roughly 2.3 KB unpacked with no new runtime dependencies or packed entries, so the reviewed unpacked baseline and its limit move up accordingly. Issue #386 drops the deprecated credential env-var and header aliases while retaining the retired names in log redaction, the credential-header rejection guard, and the Vercel preview-custody guard, and adds one-time removed-alias startup warnings plus a breaking-change CHANGELOG section and doc updates, growing compiled JS/d.ts source bytes and packed docs by roughly 7 KB unpacked with no new runtime dependencies or packed entries, so the reviewed packed and unpacked baselines and their limits move up accordingly. The consolidated Dependabot update (aws-sdk group @aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner 3.1119.0 -> 3.1125.0, zod 4.4.3 -> 4.5.4, and the dev-dependency group including @types/node 22.3.0 -> 22.20.1) refreshes the reviewed clean-consumer install footprint to the current Linux measurement of 33,616,100 bytes (the prior 32,395,660 baseline predated several merged aws-sdk/b2-sdk bumps) with no new direct or transitive production dependencies; the zod 4.5.4 bump also changes emitted nullable JSON-Schema, so the tool-contract fixtures and the LobeHub manifest tool schemas were regenerated (source/fixture text only). PR #449 rewrites the s3_get_object saveToPath download as an atomic replace through a sibling temp file, growing compiled JS/d.ts source bytes by roughly 6.0 KB packed and 26.3 KB unpacked with no new runtime dependencies or packed entries. The 2026-09-29 dependency/security batch adds pnpm overrides for newly-published advisories (fast-uri >=3.1.7, ip-address >=10.5.1, undici 6/7/8 patched lines, node-tar >=7.5.21, smol-toml >=1.7.1) to both the root and the published deploy/customer-hosted pnpm-workspace.yaml/pnpm-lock.yaml (kept byte-for-byte aligned for review parity), and retires the aged-out @backblaze-labs/b2-sdk@0.4.0 release-age exception. These grow the published unpacked bytes by ~2.3 KB with no new runtime dependencies, so the reviewed unpacked baseline and its limit move up accordingly. The 2026-10-06 dependency batch (@aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner 3.1125.0 -> 3.1144.0 with @smithy/types realigned 4.17.2 -> 4.19.0 to keep the reviewed command/type boundary on a single version, @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.0.0 -> 2.2.0, and @smithy/core re-resolved to 3.35.1 so the committed lock matches a clean consumer install) grows the clean-consumer install footprint by about 211 KB with no new direct or transitive production packages, so the reviewed clean-consumer baseline (macOS measurement 33,812,207 plus the 15,356-byte macOS-to-Linux offset measured on unmodified main) and its limit move up accordingly. Issue #524 (security advisories) moves @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.2.0 -> 2.4.0 and zod 4.5.4 -> 4.6.7 to clear GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453, GHSA-jm63-cq47-j5jp, GHSA-rvq5-wwqv-78pq and GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, with no new direct or transitive production packages; the reviewed pins move with them. The larger SDK and zod builds grow the clean-consumer install footprint by about 1.0 MB (macOS measurement 34,805,939 plus the 15,356-byte macOS-to-Linux offset), so the reviewed clean-consumer baseline and its limit move up accordingly.

@aws-sdk/client-s3.purpose: Permanent primary AWS S3 SDK dependency for B2's S3-compatible s3_* data-plane tools and usage-report object reads.
@aws-sdk/client-s3.policy: Must remain isolated behind src/s3/aws-sdk-adapter.ts; tool handlers must not construct AWS clients directly.

@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner.purpose: Permanent primary presigning dependency for B2 S3-compatible GetObject, PutObject, and UploadPart bearer URLs.
@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner.policy: Must remain isolated behind src/s3/aws-sdk-adapter.ts; presigned URL tool handlers use the repository-owned adapter contract.

@backblaze-labs/b2-sdk.purpose: Primary Backblaze B2 transport and public SDK boundary for native B2, Partner/Groups, raw, S3 helper, and simulator-backed tests.
@backblaze-labs/b2-sdk.policy: Must remain a stable npm release pinned exactly in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml.

@smithy/types.purpose: Public AWS/Smithy command and streaming-body type boundary for the permanent S3 peer adapter.
@smithy/types.policy: Must stay pinned to the version resolved through the reviewed AWS SDK dependency set.

@modelcontextprotocol/server.purpose: Stable MCP server v2 runtime for stdio and Streamable HTTP handling.
@modelcontextprotocol/server.policy: Use public v2 server exports only; do not add the monolithic v1 SDK.

jose.purpose: JOSE (JWKS/JWT) verification for the OAuth resource server local access-token path; performs JWK import and JWS signature verification for RS256/ES256/EdDSA.
jose.policy: Exact-pinned and asymmetric algorithms only. jose is a new production dependency: it was previously present only in the dev tree (via the @modelcontextprotocol/client devDependency), so a production install did not include it before. It adds exactly one package to the production closure (jose has no runtime dependencies of its own), which is why the reviewed total production package count moved to 48.

opossum.purpose: Circuit breaker runtime for bounded provider calls.
opossum.policy: Exact-pinned because major/runtime support changes can affect the Node engine floor.

pino.purpose: Structured server logging with existing secret-redaction policy.
pino.policy: No wrapper logging package may be added without review.

zod.purpose: MCP tool input schemas supplied to the server runtime.
zod.policy: Schema package additions require review; do not duplicate validation stacks.

process-warning.purpose: Reviewed pnpm migration transitive runtime package reached through pino warning paths.
process-warning.policy: Pinned by pnpm-lock.yaml after the npm-to-pnpm lock conversion moved the reviewed runtime graph from process-warning 5.0.0 to 5.1.0.
